id.description: Unique Payment identifier. Opaque, do not parse it.

account_id.description: Account the Payment is debited from.

method.description: Settlement rail the instruction travels over.
method.title: PaymentMethod

payer_name.description: Legal name of the paying party. Derived from the debited Account.

payer_account.description: IBAN or local account number the funds leave from.

beneficiary_account.description: IBAN or local account number the funds arrive at.

amount.description: Payment amount in the major unit of `currency`, excluding fees.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, applying to both `amount` and `fee_amount`.

fee_amount.description:
Settlement fee charged by the Custodian. Null until the Payment reaches
`processing`, because the Custodian quotes it on acceptance. Zero when
the rail is free.

fee_bearer.description: Which side carries the Custodian settlement fee.
fee_bearer.title: FeeBearer

value_date.description: Date the funds are due to clear.

reference.description: Remittance information shown on the beneficiary statement.

status.description:
Position in the settlement lifecycle. `cancelled` is only reachable by
withdrawing a `pending` Payment before it is sent to the Custodian.
status.title: PaymentStatus

401.description: The Bearer token is missing, malformed, or expired.

error.description: Stable, machine-readable error code. Switch on this, never on the message.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Wording may change between releases.

status.description: HTTP status code, repeated in the body for clients that log bodies only.

request_id.description: Identifier for this call. Quote it in any support request.

details.description: Present on 422 only. One entry per rejected field.

issue.example: Must be a valid ISO 4217 code.

example.message: Bearer token is missing or has expired.
